source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), 9.1.2 Perform planning/budgeting/forecasting (10738); step decomposition per MSc provenance artefact with AFP practice guides and OpsDog documentation.

steps.name: Forecast cycle initiation and assumptions refresh
steps.description: Initiate the forecast cycle per the rolling cadence: confirm forecast horizon and granularity, refresh the assumptions pack (macro indicators, corporate targets, known business events), issue timetable and templates to business units.

steps.name: Actuals collection and data preparation
steps.description: Extract closed-period actuals from the GL and management reporting systems; map to forecast structure; validate completeness and consistency with published results; load into the forecast model as the baseline.
outputs: closed-period actuals (validated baseline) loaded to forecast model

steps.name: Driver assumption updates
steps.description: Update forecast driver assumptions: volume and demand drivers from operations, pricing and rate assumptions, FX rates, headcount and cost inflation. Mix of mechanically refreshed drivers (FX, actual run-rates) and judgment-based assumptions requiring business input.

steps.name: Business unit forecast submissions
steps.description: Business units prepare and submit their forecast updates against the refreshed drivers and templates: revenue, cost, headcount and capex projections with commentary on changes since the prior forecast.

steps.name: Consolidation and validation of submissions
steps.description: Consolidate BU submissions into the group forecast model; validate completeness, internal consistency (intercompany, headcount-to-cost coherence), and continuity against actuals; chase and correct anomalous submissions.

steps.name: Variance analysis
steps.description: Analyse the consolidated forecast against budget and against the prior forecast: quantify and explain movements by driver and business unit; prepare bridge analyses and risk/opportunity schedules.

steps.name: Management review and approval
steps.description: Present the consolidated forecast and variance analysis to management; challenge sessions on key assumptions; incorporate directed revisions; obtain approval of the forecast as the current planning baseline.

steps.name: Publish forecast and reporting
steps.description: Publish the approved forecast: update planning systems and reporting baselines, distribute the forecast pack and commentary to stakeholders, archive the version with assumptions log.

requirements.statement: The variance analysis function must survive the redesign in some form.
Whatever carries the consolidation function must still consume closed-period actuals.
Management review and approval must survive in some form.
Approval must occur before the forecast is published.
Forecast publication must survive in some form.
